status: Public source prerelease and website live; v0.1.17-alpha.1 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB, Wi-Fi, an always-on relay, phone-only setup, two-account claim and signed updates over the relay; native Grok Bot calls observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: The v0.1.17-alpha.1 candidate adds Phase 12b: ADR 012 accepted, the update record (docs/verification/ota-2026-10-17.md), the guides Keep your gadget up to date, Sign and ship an update, Before you distribute a gadget and the firmware licence checklist, and the Today, next, later update. It also carries the phone-setup-to-claim guide (#338). Component pins: gateway v0.1.0-alpha.16, ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.17, Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.8 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. On 17 October 2026 the owner's kit took signed updates from the owner's relay with no cable, refused a wrong key and a changed byte, reverted an image that never came Online, recovered from a power cut and showed text from Grok Bot afterwards. Independent reproduction remains open.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; relay with accounts and signed updates used by one physical kit; native Grok Bot calls through serve --oauth observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: 404 tests (Python 3.11 to 3.14), Ruff, the first-success path, rehearse --update and the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed; PyPI 0.1.0a16 matches SHA256SUMS. Adds signed firmware updates: firmware keygen, sign, add, assign, status, list and remove; opt-in offers, 1,024-byte chunks and status reports over the device connection; update_* log lines. On 17 October 2026 the owner's relay ran the 0.1.0a16 candidate for the Phase 12b acceptance (hub docs/verification/ota-2026-10-17.md) and now runs the release on port 8443.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests and the protocol pin comparison against gateway 0.1.0-alpha.16; Ruff, package builds and the release workflow's SHA256SUMS check passed. Alpha.8 re-pins protocol 0.1.0 with the optional update frames, which the agent does not use, and pins the gateway extra to 0.1.0a16 from PyPI. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; five firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB, Wi-Fi and signed updates over the relay
components.checks: Host CTest suites (14/14, including update tests with real ECDSA and SHA-256 against the gateway fixture), the contract check and five firmware builds passed. Alpha.17 adds signed updates with automatic revert (GrokUpdate.h, GrokUpdateEsp.h); the OLED Wi-Fi build with a key uses static RAM 109,252 B and about 944 KB of flash. On 17 October 2026 the owner's kit on this firmware passed every Phase 12b item (hub docs/verification/ota-2026-10-17.md). No firmware binary is published.

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.

firmware.status: build verified; hardware and Grok pending; unpublished
